_note: customer-satisfaction-closed-loop. A survey that is sent, answered and followed up, rather than a form that exists. The V1 engine's schemas went with the forms-leaf migration, so this fragment declares the three the closed loop needs: the survey, the invitation that carries a per-recipient token, and the response. The detractor notification is a schema rule in the canonical x-openregister-notifications dialect (ADR-031): no imperative dispatch in app code.

survey.title: Survey
survey.description: One questionnaire. Questions are held as a list rather than as a schema of their own, because a survey is answered as a whole and never queried question by question.

description.title: Description
description.description: What the respondent is told before they start.

questions.title: Questions
questions.description: The questions, in order. `nps` is the 0 to 10 recommendation question; `rating` is the 1 to 5 scale; `text` is free text, which is what the verbatims come from.

key.title: Key
key.description: The key an answer is stored under.

label.title: Label
label.description: The question as the respondent reads it.

kind.title: Kind
kind.description: What kind of answer it takes.

active.title: Active
active.description: Whether the survey may still be sent.

surveyInvitation.title: Survey invitation
surveyInvitation.description: One invitation to one recipient, carrying the token their answer comes back on. Suppressed and failed invitations are PERSISTED rather than dropped: a dispatch that decided not to send is a fact worth keeping, and it is what the response rate is computed against.

token.title: Token
token.description: The per-invitation secret in the response link. Single use: once the invitation is responded or expired, the token is refused.

contactRef.title: Contact
contactRef.description: The recipient, as the Nextcloud contact uid the party model already keys on. Never an app-local customer record.

clientRef.title: Client
clientRef.description: The client the recipient belongs to, so a response rolls up to a customer.

linkedEntityType.title: Triggering entity type
linkedEntityType.description: What completed and triggered this invitation, as an `<app>:<schema>:<type>` literal.

status.title: Status
status.description: Where the invitation stands. Suppressed and failed are excluded from the response-rate denominator and shown as counts of their own.

suppressionReason.title: Suppression reason
suppressionReason.description: Machine readable, so a low response rate can be explained rather than guessed at.

dispatchRuleId.title: Dispatch rule
dispatchRuleId.description: The rule that created this invitation.

scheduledFor.title: Scheduled for
scheduledFor.description: When the delay elapses and the invitation may be sent.

expiresAt.title: Expires at
expiresAt.description: After this the token opens a closed page rather than the form.

deliveryAddress.title: Delivery address
deliveryAddress.description: The address this invitation was addressed to, recorded at the moment the dispatch decided to send. Held on the invitation rather than resolved again at send time, because a contact whose email changes between the decision and the send would otherwise get a message that the record cannot account for.

surveyResponse.title: Survey response
surveyResponse.description: One filled-in survey. The classification is written by the follow-up service and is what the detractor notification rule below transitions on, so the notification is a schema rule rather than an imperative dispatch in app code (ADR-031).

invitationRef.title: Invitation
invitationRef.description: The invitation it came back on. Absent for a response collected outside the closed loop.

clientRef.title: Client
clientRef.description: The client this response rolls up to.

answers.title: Answers
answers.description: The answers, keyed by question key.

npsScore.title: NPS score
npsScore.description: The 0 to 10 recommendation answer, lifted out of the answers so it can be aggregated without reading every response.

averageRating.title: Average rating
averageRating.description: The mean of the 1 to 5 answers.

verbatim.title: Verbatim
verbatim.description: The free text, which is the part a manager actually reads.

classification.title: Classification
classification.description: Bain's NPS bands, with a rating at or below the configured threshold also counting as a detractor. Written by the follow-up service; the notification rule below transitions on it.

followUpTaskRef.title: Follow-up task
followUpTaskRef.description: The My Work task a detractor response raised.

followUpAssignee.title: Follow-up assignee
followUpAssignee.description: Who owns the follow-up: the client's owner, or the configured default assignee when the client has none. Named here because the detractor notification rule takes its recipient from this field, so an ownerless client still reaches somebody rather than nobody.

message.nl: Er is een ontevreden reactie binnengekomen. De opvolgtaak staat in Mijn werk.
message.en: An unhappy response came in. The follow-up task is in My work.

surveyOptOut.title: Survey opt-out
surveyOptOut.description: Whether this contact has asked never to be sent a satisfaction survey again. Honoured by every dispatch rule, and settable by the respondent from the public form itself.
